Name: Micaiah, Son of Imlah
Summary: Micaiah, son of Imlah, was the one prophet Ahab hated because he never prophesied good of him; he saw the LORD send a lying spirit to Ahab's prophets and foretold Ahab's death at Ramoth-gilead, and was imprisoned on bread and water.
KeyStory: Micaiah alone foretells Ahab's death at Ramoth-gilead.
RelatedPeople: King Ahab; King Jehoshaphat; Zedekiah, Son of Chenaanah; Imlah, Father of Micaiah
LifeLesson: One true voice against four hundred is still the majority when God has spoken.
